options.name: action
options.description: The configured action for the policy rule.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: auditor_notification
options.description: Notification template for DLP email alerts. Provide as dict with C(id) key.

options.name: bucket_owner
options.description: A user who inspects their buckets for sensitive data. When you choose a user, their buckets are available in the Buckets field.

options.name: buckets
options.description: List of bucket IDs for the Zscaler service to inspect for sensitive data.

options.name: casb_email_label
options.description: Email label associated with the rule. Provide as dict with C(id) key.

options.name: casb_tombstone_template
options.description: Quarantine tombstone template. Provide as dict with C(id) key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: cloud_app_tenant_ids
options.description: List of cloud application tenant IDs for which the rule is applied.

options.name: collaboration_scope
options.description: Collaboration scope for the rule.

options.name: components
options.description: List of components for which the rule is applied. Zscaler service inspects these components for sensitive data.

options.name: content_location
options.description: The location for the content that the Zscaler service inspects for sensitive data.

options.name: criteria_domain_profile_ids
options.description: List of domain profile IDs that are mandatory in the criteria.

options.name: departments
options.description: List of department IDs for which the rule is applied.

options.name: description
options.description: An admin editable text-based description of the rule.

options.name: dlp_engines
options.description: List of DLP engine IDs to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: domains
options.description: The domain for the external organization sharing the channel. Only applicable when content_location is C(CONTENT_LOCATION_SHARED_CHANNEL).

options.name: email_recipient_profile_ids
options.description: List of recipient profile IDs for which the rule is applied.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Administrative state of the rule. If C(true), rule is ENABLED. If C(false), rule is DISABLED.

options.name: entity_group_ids
options.description: List of entity group IDs that are part of the rule criteria.

options.name: excluded_domain_profile_ids
options.description: List of domain profile IDs excluded from the criteria for the rule.

options.name: external_auditor_email
options.description: Email address of the external auditor to whom the DLP email alerts are sent.

options.name: file_types
options.description: File types for which the rule is applied. If not set, applied across all file types.

options.name: groups
options.description: List of group IDs for which the rule is applied.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for the CASB DLP rule. Used to reference an existing rule for update or delete.

options.name: include_criteria_domain_profile
options.description: If true, criteria_domain_profiles is included as part of the criteria, else excluded.

options.name: include_email_recipient_profile
options.description: If true, email_recipient_profiles is included as part of the criteria, else excluded.

options.name: include_entity_groups
options.description: If true, entity_groups is included as part of the criteria, else excluded.

options.name: included_domain_profile_ids
options.description: List of domain profile IDs included in the criteria for the rule.

options.name: labels
options.description: List of rule label IDs associated with the rule.

options.name: name
options.description: Rule name.

options.name: object_type_ids
options.description: List of object type IDs for which the rule is applied.

options.name: order
options.description: Order of rule execution with respect to other SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rules.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: quarantine_location
options.description: Location where all the quarantined files are moved and necessary actions are taken.

options.name: rank
options.description: Admin rank assigned to this rule. Mandatory when admin rank-based access restriction is enabled.

options.name: receiver
options.description: Details of the DLP Incident Receiver, Provide as dict with C(id) key.

options.name: recipient
options.description: Specifies if the email recipient is internal or external.

options.name: redaction_profile
options.description: Redaction profile in the criteria. Provide as dict with C(id) key.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: severity
options.description: The severity level of the incidents that match the policy rule.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: tag
options.description: Tag applied to the rule. Provide as dict with C(id) key.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: List of user IDs for which the rule is applied.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: watermark_delete_old_version
options.description: Specifies whether to delete an old version of the watermarked file.

options.name: watermark_profile
options.description: Watermark profile applied to the rule. Provide as dict with C(id) key.

options.name: without_content_inspection
options.description: If true, Content Matching is set to None.

options.name: zscaler_incident_receiver
options.description: Zscaler Incident Receiver details. Provide as dict with C(id) key.
